en: Nārāyaṇa, Nārāyaṇa, victory to you, O Govinda, O Hari!
Nārāyaṇa, Nārāyaṇa, victory to Gopāla, O Hari! (Chorus)
O Narayana, as deep as the ocean of Varuna, the boundless expanse of compassion! 1.
O Nārāyaṇa, who resembles a dense rain-cloud and who has brought about the destruction of the impurities of the Kali age! 2.
O Nārāyaṇa, who dwells on the banks of the Yamunā and wears a necklace of Kaustubha jewels! 3.
O wearer of yellow garments, O treasure-trove of divine auspiciousness, O Nārāyaṇa! 4.
O Mañjulaguñja, adorned with ornaments, you who have assumed the illusory form of a human; O Nārāyaṇa! 5.
O connoisseur of the sweetness of Rādhā’s lip, O moon among the lunar dynasty, O Nārāyaṇa! 6.
O Nārāyaṇa, whose feet are praised by the Vedas, and who finds delight in the music of the muralī flute! 7.
O Nārāyaṇa, who crushes the peacock, who plays with the serpent as his crown-ornament, and who performs the dance of the drama! 8.
O you who are adorned with ornaments of lotuses, O beloved of Rukmiṇī, O Nārāyaṇa! 9.
O Nārāyaṇa, whose eyes resemble lotus petals, the thread that initiates the creation of the world! 10.
O destroyer of the night of sin, O abode of compassion, uplift me! O Nārāyaṇa! 11.
O destroyer of Agha, Bakasura, and Kaṃsa; O Keśava, Kṛṣṇa, Murāri; O Nārāyaṇa! 12.
O Nārāyaṇa, you who wear yellow garments resembling gold, grant me fearlessness; do not conceal yourself from me. 13.
O Prince Daśaratha, destroyer of the pride of the Dānavas! O Nārāyaṇa! 14.
O delighter of Govardhana Hill, O captivator of the hearts of the gopīs, O Nārāyaṇa! 15.
O Nārāyaṇa, you who are the celestial coral tree for the virtuous sages dwelling on the banks of the Śarayu! 16.
O Nārāyaṇa, you who witnessed the various supreme deeds of Viśvāmitra! 17.
O you who hold the banner, the vajra, and the goad; O you who rejoice together with the Son of the Earth; O Nārāyaṇa! 18.
Victory, victory to you, O protector of Janaka’s daughter, O play of worldly existence! O Nārāyaṇa! 19.
O Nārāyaṇa, who bore the burden of fulfilling Daśaratha’s word and wandered through the Daṇḍaka forest! 20.
O Nārāyaṇa, who brought about the destruction of Muṣṭika and Cāṇūra, and who sports in the minds of sages! 21.
O hero who subdued Vālin, O noble friend of Sugrīva, O Nārāyaṇa! 22.
O Śrīdhara, O Nārāyaṇa, protect me, protect me, you fisherman who holds the flute in your hand! 23.
O Nārāyaṇa, steadfast in binding the ocean, you who rend the throat of Rāvaṇa! 24.
O Nārāyaṇa, rich in the various merits of the dancer [the Lord], and enriched by the abundant blossoming of the *tāṭī* flower! 25.
O Gaurīpati, worshiper of the wife of Gautama; O you whose gaze is thick with compassion! O Nārāyaṇa! 26.
The abduction of Sītā in agitation, the wandering in the city of Sāketa, and Nārāyaṇa. 27.
O Nārāyaṇa, whose hand trembles as it uproots the immovable [mountains], you who are intent upon bestowing grace upon your devotees! 28.
O Nārāyaṇa, who delights in the songs of merchants, O Prahlāda, son of a Rākṣasa! 29.
O Nārāyaṇa, the nectar of the name Śaṅkara, the best of Indian sages, [resides] within the interior of all. 30.
Thus ends the Nārāyaṇa-stotra composed by the venerable Śaṅkarācārya.
